resources.string: Home opens on your readiness reading and the deadlines nearest to passing. Below them: the opportunities that matched your skills since the last time you looked, and the applications you already started.
Explore holds every internship and hackathon Sagitta is tracking. Filter by city, stipend or closing date, then save what is worth following — saved listings are what your alerts watch.
The AI hub reads the profile you built during onboarding, so a resume critique or a roadmap is answered against your own skills and timeline rather than generic advice.

Growth plots the skills you have earned and the score history behind them. Each point comes from something you did in the app — practice, projects, consistency — so a weak area is visible as a gap, not a guess.
Profile keeps your saved opportunities, applications, portfolio and the controls for alerts, data and privacy. If something you bookmarked is missing, it is here first.
Tap any station to move between these five sections. New matches and closing deadlines arrive as notifications on their own — you do not have to hunt for them.
